# GPX.photos - Full Technical Specification & Agent Reference

> GPX.photos is a browser-based application that overlays 3D GPS route paths and athletic telemetry plaques directly onto adventure and race photography without uploading user photos or GPX files to any server.

## Overview & Architecture

- **Domain**: https://gpx.photos
- **Application Category**: MultimediaApplication, Sports & Fitness Art Studio
- **Platform Architecture**: 100% Client-side HTML5 Canvas 2D/3D matrix projection with optional server-side layout assistance via Gemini Vision.
- **Privacy Model**: Zero-upload architecture. Photos and GPS coordinates remain strictly in browser RAM. No telemetry or images are saved to external cloud storage.

## Key Features

1. **3D Route Perspective Projection**:
   - Projects 2D GPS latitude/longitude coordinates onto photo ground planes using yaw, pitch, tilt, and vertical elevation scaling.
   - Multiple styling modes: Volumetric Tube with ambient ground drop shadow, Molten Laser filament bloom, Neon Ridge, and Archival Minimalist.
2. **Glassmorphic Statistics HUD Plaque**:
   - Floating telemetry plaque displaying distance, duration, elevation gain, and average pace/speed.
   - Customizable styles: Neon Rim Glow, 100% Transparent (using route line color), Carbon Fiber, and Frosted Ice.
   - Full 0% to 90% vertical positioning and 0% to 85% horizontal alignment.
   - Dynamic scaling from 60% up to 250% with automatic portrait aspect ratio compensation.
3. **Synchronized Elevation Profile Ribbon**:
   - Profile area gradient with peak marker dot, summit altitude label, start elevation, and elevation gain badge.
   - Dynamic height scaling up to 140px.
4. **4K Export & Licensing**:
   - Free Social Edition ($0): Full resolution export with official gpx.photos hallmark emblem in any corner.
   - Clean Master Edition ($10): 100% unbranded 300 DPI master download with permanent watermark removal via Paystack checkout.

## Structured Endpoints

- **GET /**: Homepage (HTML or Markdown when requested with `Accept: text/markdown`).
- **GET /studio**: Direct access to the interactive studio workspace.
- **GET /llms.txt**: Index of agent resources.
- **GET /llms-full.txt**: Full technical documentation.
- **GET /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json**: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server descriptor.
- **POST /api/auto-style**: Accepts `{ imageBase64: string }` and returns AI-recommended widget bounding boxes and style palette.
